entries.title: Isaiah 63:1
segments: ¶Who [is] this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this [that is] glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save. {glorious: Heb. decked}

entries.title: Isaiah 63:2
segments: Wherefore [art thou] red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:3
segments: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people [there was] none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

words.text: with me: for I will tread

entries.title: Isaiah 63:4
segments: For the day of vengeance [is] in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:5
segments: And I looked, and [there was] none to help; and I wondered that [there was] none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:6
segments: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:7
segments: ¶I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, [and] the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

words.text: , according to all that the LORD
on them according to his mercies

entries.title: Isaiah 63:8
segments: For he said, Surely they [are] my people, children [that] will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:9
segments: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:10
segments: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, [and] he fought against them.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:11
segments: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, [and] his people, [saying], Where [is] he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where [is] he that put his holy Spirit within him? {shepherd: or, shepherds}

words.text: , [saying], Where [is] he that brought them up

entries.title: Isaiah 63:12
segments: That led [them] by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:13
segments: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, [that] they should not stumble?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:14
segments: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:15
segments: ¶Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where [is] thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained? {the sounding: or, the multitude}

entries.title: Isaiah 63:16
segments: Doubtless thou [art] our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, [art] our father, our redeemer; thy name [is] from everlasting. {our redeemer...: or, our redeemer from everlasting is thy name}

words.text: . {our redeemer...: or, our redeemer from everlasting is thy name}

entries.title: Isaiah 63:17
segments: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, [and] hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

words.text: , why hast thou made us to err

entries.title: Isaiah 63:18
segments: The people of thy holiness have possessed [it] but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:19
segments: We are [thine]: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name. {they...: Heb. thy name was not called upon them}

words.text: over them; they were not called
. {they...: Heb. thy name was not called upon them}
